Rec-arrays

Source: R/io-values-rec-array.R
io-rec-array.Rd

Reads and writes the Element rec-array, version 0.2.0, a structured (compound) dataset such as scanpy's rank_genes_groups results in uns.

Usage

new_rec_array(x)

write_rec_array(store, key, value, dataset_kwargs, path)

Arguments

x

A data.frame.

store

An open rhdf5 file or group handle.

key

Name of the Element within store.

value

A rec-array made by new_rec_array().

dataset_kwargs

A list of dataset creation options.

path

Path of the Element.

Details

The R value is a data.frame with the extra class anndata_rec_array (made by new_rec_array()), which keeps the field names, field order and field values.

Field dtypes are kept (ADR 0008, the field types come from a compiled helper because rhdf5 cannot see or build compound types). A field read from HDF5 or zarr carries an On-disk dtype record, unless it has the R type, and writing restores it. Integer fields are read as integer (or double when they do not fit) with the record "uint8", "int64" and so on, f4 fields as double with the record "float32", and booleans as logical. Strings are character, with the record "h5_fixed_ascii:<bytes>", "h5_fixed_utf8:<bytes>" or "h5_vlen_ascii" unless they are variable-length UTF-8 as h5py writes text (zarr records "<type>:<length_bytes>"). Fields without a record are written as int32, float64, bool and variable-length UTF-8 strings, which Python reads with any text. A recorded string width is widened when the text no longer fits, and a fixed-length or ASCII record becomes variable-length UTF-8 for non-ASCII text, as does a fixed-length UTF-8 record, because anndata cannot read either as a fixed-length field. Integer and string fields cannot hold NA, so writing one raises anndata_io_registry_error. A rec-array with no rows is written, and compression = "gzip" in dataset_kwargs compresses an HDF5 rec-array (zarr uses compressors). Integers of 2^53 or more raise anndata_dtype_overflow_error on read.

Deviations from Python

"lzf" is not available to the compound helper, so an HDF5 rec-array is written uncompressed under it. See vignette("deviations") for the full list.
